source_analysis.contrast_policy: AA/AAA-first: body text 7:1 target, CTA text >= 4.5:1

contrast_report.wcag_note: Valores >= 4.5 son AA para texto normal; bg_text apunta a >= 7 cuando el palette lo permite.

design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #120D09; --surface: #22180F; --surface-alt: #342417; --text: #FFF7ED; --muted: #D9C4AA; --primary: #D97706; --accent: #4ADE80; --on-primary: #000000; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 18px; --gap: 16px; --blur: 18px; --nav-position: fixed; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; } .testimonial-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, var(--primary))); border: 1px solid var(--border); } .testimonial-card__stars { color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: .16em; } .avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

services_grid.content_strategy: wide service track with alternating large cards
